plugins.name: Gratis Backup
plugins.reviewNotes: Stream-first backup & restore engine with PathGuard, SHA-256 verification, SQLite backup API, MYSQL_PWD env passing (no CLI password leak), DB_HOST host:port/socket/IPv6 parser, exec() availability guard, and 21-assertion restore-selfcheck.php.

plugins.name: Gratis Mail
plugins.reviewNotes: Clean SMTP mailer with OpenSSL/salt-encrypted credentials, test email form, delivery log, and WP-CLI.

plugins.name: Gratis Social
plugins.reviewNotes: Zero-tracking share buttons (inline, floating, shortcode) with clean settings and no third-party JS SDK.

plugins.name: Gratis Reviews
plugins.reviewNotes: Accessible star ratings, testimonial grids, nonce+honeypot review submission form, and Schema.org AggregateRating markup.

plugins.name: Gratis Analytics
plugins.reviewNotes: Cookie-free privacy-first analytics with daily-rotating salted hashes, DNT support, retention pruning, and WP 6.2+ %i SQL identifier escaping.

plugins.name: Gratis Comply
plugins.reviewNotes: Accessible cookie consent banner with Google Consent Mode v2, script gating, privacy policy generator, hashed consent log, and per-visitor rate limiting on both /consent and /data-request REST endpoints.

plugins.name: Gratis Forms
plugins.reviewNotes: Form builder with dedicated submissions table, CSV export, honeypot + optional Google reCAPTCHA v3 (disclosed in Third-Party Services), and %i SQL identifier escaping.

plugins.name: Gratis Popup
plugins.reviewNotes: Accessible modal/slide-in popups with focus trap, reduced-motion support, frequency caps, and clean block/shortcode rendering without calling core the_content filter.

plugins.name: Gratis CDN
plugins.reviewNotes: Asset URL rewriting, content-hash fingerprinting, and authenticated Cloudflare/BunnyCDN/KeyCDN/webhook purge with Third-Party Services disclosures and ABSPATH guards.

plugins.name: Gratis Commerce
plugins.reviewNotes: Stripe Checkout with replay-protected HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification, idempotent order recording, rate-limited published-product session creation, sanitized webhook meta, plus WooCommerce quick view, wishlist, compare, and AJAX filters.

plugins.name: Gratis CRM
plugins.reviewNotes: Contact manager with broadcast campaigns, HMAC unsubscribe tokens, formula-safe CSV export (PHP 8.4+ fputcsv safe), prefixed taxonomy gratis_contact_tag, and show_in_rest=false on private gratis_contact CPT.

plugins.name: Gratis Booking
plugins.reviewNotes: Services/appointments CPTs, configurable business hours & minute-accurate slot stepping, rate-limited & slot-validated REST booking preventing double-booking/email spam, and confirmation emails.

plugins.name: Gratis Tables
plugins.reviewNotes: CSV-backed responsive data tables with keyboard-accessible sorting, client-side search enqueued via wp_add_inline_script, PHP 8.4+ str_getcsv safety, and show_in_rest=false on private gratis_table CPT.

plugins.name: Gratis Invoice
plugins.reviewNotes: Line-item invoices with auto-recalculated totals, per-invoice edit_post-gated printable HTML output, show_in_rest=false closing client PII exposure, and multi-currency settings.

plugins.name: Gratis Learn
plugins.reviewNotes: Courses, ordered lessons, private quiz CPT (show_in_rest=false), published-lesson progress REST endpoint, and outline/catalog shortcode.

plugins.name: Gratis Automation
plugins.reviewNotes: Trigger-to-action workflow engine with monotonic IDs, cron cleanup on delete, wp_safe_remote_post webhooks, ABSPATH guard, and Third-Party Services disclosure.

plugins.name: Gratis Affiliate
plugins.reviewNotes: Referral codes, hardened HttpOnly/SameSite attribution cookie, commission tracking, and admin payout tool.

plugins.name: Gratis Community
plugins.reviewNotes: Extended user profiles (per-user meta auth_callback), activity feed shortcode/REST, groups CPT, private direct messages (show_in_rest=false, post_status=private, recipient validation + rate limit).

plugins.name: Gratis Events
plugins.reviewNotes: Events with start/end/venue/capacity/recurrence, published-only rate-limited & sanitized RSVP endpoint, and iCal export. Note: still uses taxonomy slug event_category (referenced by gratis-theme archive template; prefix with migration before slot #20 if requested).

plugins.name: Gratis Media
plugins.reviewNotes: Media library folders using prefixed taxonomy gratis_media_folder, auto-organize on upload, bulk organizer, and lazy-loaded gallery shortcode.

plugins.name: GRATIS Builder
plugins.reviewNotes: Gutenberg pattern library, per-post edit_post-gated block editing REST API with innerContent sync, rate-limited AI generation endpoint, and directory listings with prefixed taxonomies (gratis_listing_category/gratis_listing_location), hardened meta auth, and working frontend submission handler.

plugins.name: Gratis Access
plugins.reviewNotes: Tiered content restriction across singular views, excerpts, RSS feeds, and REST responses; prefixed gratis_access_level taxonomy with option-guarded seeding; manage_options-gated _access_level user meta.

plugins.name: Gratis Project
plugins.reviewNotes: Projects & tasks CPTs (show_in_rest=false closing internal data leak), MetaBox, and Kanban board shortcode. Note: still uses taxonomy slug task_status (used on live demo board; prefix with migration before slot #24 if requested).

plugins.name: Gratis Translate
plugins.reviewNotes: Multilingual content linking using prefixed taxonomy gratis_language (avoids Polylang language collision) with option-guarded seeding, accessible language switcher, and hreflang tags.

plugins.name: Gratis Fleet
plugins.reviewNotes: Multi-site manager. Hardened: fixed arbitrary do_action injection in WebhookHub::receive, wp_safe_remote_post webhooks, cached DB size query, removed all 4 sslverify=false flags, added ABSPATH guards (including WorkerEndpoint) & Third-Party Services disclosures.

plugins.name: Gratis AI
plugins.reviewNotes: BYOM OpenAI-compatible AI router, encrypted key vault, hardened MCP server (input type/sanitization/days clamp), and Abilities API integration. Remaining 4 PCP warnings are informational WP 7.0 AIProvider.DirectIntegration advisories.

plugins.name: Gratis Security
blockers: Admin UI and FIM status strings across 7 files (Settings.php, FileIntegrity.php, Admin/{Wizard,Malware,Requests,Server,Feeds}Tab.php — 636 Lithuanian diacritic chars) are written in Lithuanian instead of English en_US source strings required by WordPress.org GlotPress.

15+ @shell_exec() OS probes (systemctl, auditctl, ps, getenforce, git, sha256sum) across FileIntegrity, MalwareScanner, and ServerInspector require WordPress.org manual-review audit or explicit opt-in gating.
plugins.reviewNotes: Strong WAF, FIM, malware scanner, and 4 passing self-check suites, but held back from WordPress.org submission until all 7 admin/core files use en_US source strings (with lt_LT translation files) and shell_exec probes are reviewed.

plugins.name: Gratis Cache
blockers: Legacy 3-char vlt_* prefix across 40+ wp_options, REST namespace (vlt-cache/v1), and AJAX action (vlt_async_worker) requires full prefix migration to gratis_cache_* before WP.org submission.
Admin UI pages contain hardcoded Lithuanian strings across 17 files instead of en_US source strings.
Defines core SAVEQUERIES and DISABLE_WP_CRON constants inside plugin runtime; dynamic job hook dispatch in AsyncQueue (6 remaining PCP warnings, down from 45).
plugins.reviewNotes: Removed mcp-for-page-builders/v1 arbitrary file/option write endpoints, removed 3 sslverify=false flags, removed 3 set_time_limit(0) calls with 25s SSE bounds, wrapped global $_vlt_* vars in closure, cached stats queries, and added ABSPATH guards to 59 files.

plugins.name: Gratis DB
blockers: DropinManager directly writes/removes wp-content/db.php drop-in files on disk; review WP.org Guideline 8/file-modification requirements.
SlowQueryLog defines WordPress core constant SAVEQUERIES at runtime (1 remaining PCP warning, down from 8).
plugins.reviewNotes: Upgraded Migrator and TableOptimizer to WP 6.2+ %i SQL identifier escaping (0 PCP errors) and added ABSPATH guard to DropinManager.

plugins.name: Gratis DevTools
blockers: MigrationManager writes PHP files into wp-content/gratis-migrations/ and executes them via require (high WP.org manual review rejection risk).
DebugBar defines core SAVEQUERIES constant at runtime (1 remaining PCP warning, down from 8); StagingManager uses MySQL-only CREATE TABLE LIKE.
plugins.reviewNotes: Upgraded StagingManager to WP 6.2+ %i SQL identifier escaping, added ABSPATH guards, and removed competitor pricing copy.

plugins.name: Gratis Notify
blockers: Thin stub (98 LOC PushNotifier.php): no real Web Push (no VAPID keys, no Service Worker delivery), front-end script never polls /latest or displays notifications, and /subscribe appends unbounded entries to wp_options without rate limiting.
plugins.reviewNotes: Needs a real notification polling/Web Push delivery implementation before WordPress.org submission.

plugins.name: Gratis Installer
blockers: Not suitable for WordPress.org Plugin Directory (Guidelines 1 & 10): only lists 32 hardcoded juslintek/gratis-* plugins and activates copies already present on disk, with promotional pricing copy and no standalone general-user utility.
plugins.reviewNotes: Keep as a GitHub/direct-download suite helper rather than submitting to wordpress.org.
